verdict.rationale: Reply templates and snippets are a fair capability to ask of an email client, but the evidence pack never mentions saved templates, snippets, or variable substitution in Outlook. The Graph API's draft-message and attachment endpoints are developer building blocks for constructing such a feature, not the feature itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
